# Gate33 / Preview 7

- Added BRAIN-style M2 instrument participation: turn to enable/exclude, click any encoder to switch groups.
- Capture and A/B editing remain available for excluded tracks; all Morph sound writes respect routing.
- Enabled the SDK stock M4 LFO page and follow its Morph destination while LIVE.
- Added bounded autonomous target sampling so continuous modulation cannot starve later tracks/readback.
- Persisted routing without enlarging the saved payload; retain Gate32 format compatibility.
- Preserved the existing movement recorder, guarded SHIFT writes, manual bypass, stock erase gestures and manager safeguards.

Gate32 was reported working without regressions by the owner. Gate33 is a distinct development revision awaiting native build/allocation and device acceptance.
